children.game_version: A 'Trousers Off' game where children mimic the brushing motion to music, freezing when the music stops.

seniors.seated_version: Perform the brushing and leg movements while seated, focusing on ankle mobility.
seniors.standing_version: Use a chair for balance while practicing the brushing steps at a reduced tempo.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduce tempo to 70-80 bpm; limit range of motion for highcuts.

movement_profile.footwork: Brushing, shedding, highcuts, entrechats, and back-stepping.

signature_moves.description: The initial movement of the dance involving sweeping leg motions.
signature_moves.name: Brushing

signature_moves.description: A technical movement involving the rapid movement of the feet.
signature_moves.name: Shedding

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Starts slow and controlled, accelerates to fast and energetic.

music_profile.sound_description: The music transitions from a moderate, rhythmic tempo suitable for brushing movements to a significantly faster, driving pace that supports high-energy, percussive footwork.

teaching.level_notes: Dancers typically begin in the beginner category and progress through to the premier level.
